meta.title: SafeHer Partner Portal
meta.description: Sign in to manage your organization's availability for SafeHer referrals.

login.title: Partner sign in
login.intro: For verified SafeHer partner organizations. If your organization is not yet part of the network, apply through Get Involved.
login.invalid: That email address and password did not match an account. Please check both and try again.
login.missing: Please enter both your email address and your password.
login.error: Something went wrong signing you in. Please try again.
login.applyCta: Apply to join the SafeHer network
login.mockBody: The portal is not connected to the real partner system yet, and these are seeded test accounts. Do not enter a real password here, and do not record anything about a real girl or a real referral.
login.unconfiguredHeading: Sign-in is not enabled in this environment
login.unconfiguredBody: No partner accounts are configured here, so no sign-in will succeed. This is deliberate: the portal is still running on seeded test accounts, and those are never enabled on a deployed site unless someone turns them on explicitly.

availability.title: Your availability
availability.intro: The matching engine only refers a girl to a partner that has confirmed it can receive her. Keep this current — this is what stands between her and a closed door.
availability.neverSetBody: Your organization is treated as closed until you set this. That is deliberate: SafeSiso will not send anyone to a partner it has not heard from.
availability.statusLabel: Can you receive a referral right now?

available.label: Yes — accepting referrals
available.help: You can receive a girl now. The matching engine may refer to you.

full.label: At capacity
full.help: You are open but cannot take anyone else right now. No referrals will be sent.

closed.label: Closed
closed.help: Not reachable at all right now. No referrals will be sent.

availability.slotsHelp: Optional. Leave blank if your organization does not track this.
availability.noteHelp: Optional, and not shown to anyone seeking help. For example, reduced hours this week.
availability.invalidSlots: Please enter a whole number of places, or leave it blank.
availability.invalidStatus: Please choose one of the available options.
availability.failed: Your change could not be saved, so your availability is unchanged. Please try again.
availability.privacyNote: This portal holds availability only. It never shows conversation content, and it never identifies a girl — SafeSiso does not collect that information in the first place.
